scope: Twelve standalone facilities in high/low detail calibrated to bird v41. Source and emitted attributes within 1e-6, metadata within 1e-12. Actual imported bird contact, combined habitat and physical mobile performance are separate gates.
samplingPolicy: Anisotropy 4 is reapplied equally on source and import. Runtime stock uses named meshes and retained water-well parameters; GLB defaults to full [4,4].
closedScope: Each solid component and each round wire is checked separately; welded wire crossings and intentional component overlaps are not a Boolean-unioned printable solid. Thin cards, labels, fill and water planes are intentionally open.
